title: UiFormulaRule - Data API
description: Represents a set of one or more filters that define the conditions under which a component displays on a Lightning page. This object is available in API version 47.0 and later.

AssociatedElementId.description: Represents a parent component that UiFormulaRule is associated with, such as PromptVersion. This is a relationship field.

BooleanFilter.description: Represents the filter logic applied to UiFormulaRule. References the UI formula rule stored by UiFormulaCriterion based on the sortIndex, such as ((1 && 3) || 2).

DeveloperName.description: Represents the API name of the UiFormulaRule. Note: Only users with View DeveloperName OR View Setup and Configuration permission can view, group, sort, and filter this field.

Formula.description: Represents the formula source string of UiFormulaRule.

Language.description: Represents the language of the UiFormulaRule.

MasterLabel.description: Represents the label of the UiFormulaRule.

ParentKeyPrefix.description: Represents the three-digit prefix for AssociatedElementId.
